column3: “Begun” is supplied; them pluralizes the singular object of I have cursed it.
“Descendants” specifies seed; the carrying away is rendered passively.
“Continue” interprets the covenant being with Levi.
“It called for reverence” supplies a clause for fear.
The instruction becomes the subject of causing to stumble, instead of you.
“By marrying” makes the marriage the means of profaning instead of joining it with and.
“Awake and aware” renders waking and answering; even if replaces and before the one bringing an offering.
The opening is phrased as a question; the LORD and them are supplied, and one is made the object. Godly interprets of God, and the final third-person prohibition becomes direct address.
“I hate” replaces he hates; he who divorces his wife supplies an explicit subject for the following covering of the garment.
